prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1415; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the head-on collision described in your file. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver, along with the declarations page and a statement of any other coverage that may apply, including umbrella or excess policies. Please confirm receipt of this request in writing.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, repair estimates, adjuster notes, recorded statements, telematics records, and any communications with the insured or third parties. Routine destruction or alteration of these materials should be suspended until the claim is fully resolved.

Our client intends to pursue full compensation for medical expenses, lost income, and pain and suffering. We look forward to your prompt response.
